limitations: Track IDs are run-local and are not persistent person identities.
Raw video and rendered frames are not embedded in this report.
Variant acceptance remains an explicit human decision.
Metrics use visiontrack.metrics/v2: fragmentations mark resumed matches; historical v1 scores and failure definitions are not directly comparable.
Input filtering uses visiontrack.mot17-preprocessing/v2; historical Lab preprocessing is not directly comparable. Versioned evaluation is not evidence of improved tracking accuracy.
